title: Biscuits and Gravy by Shaun C. Tyson
description:
Novels and Nibbles caters to the littlest Small Café guests this week. Biscuit and Gravy are called heroes after saving their town’s fire station. Curious about who else helps their community, they set out to find other hometown heroes and learn about the important jobs these people do. They found firefighters, farmers and many others reminding us you do not need a cape to make a difference. So true. Bonus…the picture book also includes a seek-and-find activity for readers!

Guess what we have this week?! Biscuits and Gravy. YES! Once upon a breakfast, two big fluffy buttermilk biscuits snuggled under a cozy blanket of creamy sausage gravy. Then two eggs, cooked any way you like, joined the adventure. A sprinkle of green onions added a little magic, and they all lived yummily ever after. The End!

Come reward your heroic tummy with a dish that’s ever so yummy!
